_source: Retail's answer to a player's status on an enemy, from every player's ActionEffect on an NPC in 26 of Bob's and Connor's Chronofoil captures (2026-11-18; /tmp scan of effect kinds 14, the status given, and 55, the status named with no effect): only Stun (2) was ever refused, 1,336 times, by White Mage's Holy (139) 1,323 of them.
_immune: BNpcBase IDs that refused the status every time, the first included (no use ever took hold): Cape Westwind's four (14582, 14583: 59 of 59), Castrum Meridianum's bosses and others.
_diminishing: Every other enemy took it for the full time, then half, then a quarter, then not at all (4, 2, 1 s, refused: 183 runs of Holy on 43 kinds of enemy). A use counts towards the next once it's `counted_after` seconds old: two Holys 2.5 s apart often both got the same time (1,090 of 1,138 uses fit 2.5 s; the 48 that don't were refused 2.4-2.5 s after a quarter). How long the refusing lasts wasn't seen to end: 48.6 s after the last that took hold at the longest, so `forget_after` is a guess.
